text:
One of the easiest ways to turn Grok Bot into a real assistant:

Give it its own email address.

- Not my Gmail.
- Not a shared team@ inbox.
- Its own address.

I set mine up with @agentmail, then connected an inbound webhook so the agent wakes up whenever an email arrives.

From there, the workflow is ridiculously simple:

-> I CC my @bot on emails.

-> If I want it to take action, I put the instruction on the last line:

-> “Book Tuesday at 3pm and get back to them.”

That’s it.

>> The agent then reads the thread

>> knows the instruction came from me

>> books the calendar

>> replies to everyone on the same thread

>> sends the calendar invite from its own email address

The important part is that I’m not opening another app and assigning tasks.

I’m delegating inside the workflow I already use.
